course.title: Power System Operation and Control
course.department: Department of Electrical and Electronic Engineering

content.value: A 440 V, 50 Hz, 6-pole, Y-connected wound rotor motor has the following parameters: $\mathrm { R } _ { \mathrm { s } } = 0 . 5 \ \Omega , \mathrm { R } _ { \mathrm { r } } ^ { \prime } = 0 . 4 \ \Omega , \mathrm { X } _ { \mathrm { s } } = \mathrm { X } _ { \mathrm { r } } ^ { \prime } = 1 . 2 \ \Omega , \mathrm { X } _ { \mathrm { m } } = 5 0 \ \Omega ,$ and stator to rotor turns ratio is 3.5. Motor is controlled by static rotor resistance control. External resistance is chosen such that the breakdown torque is produced at standstill for a duty ratio of zero. Calculate the value of external resistance. How duty ratio should be varied with speed so that the motor accelerates at maximum torque.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2018
